condition: foul-smelling thick yellow-green discharge draining strictly from the right nostril for 6 days in a 3-year-old toddler
level_rationale: Six days of foul-smelling thick yellow-green mucus draining strictly from only the right nostril in a 3-year-old toddler who attends playgroup is the classic presentation of an occult unilateral nasal foreign body warranting a same-day or prompt outpatient clinic visit for anterior rhinoscopy and safe foreign-body removal rather than home care alone or emergency resuscitation, whereas having a little thin watery mucus from both nostrils for 1 day represents trivial uncomplicated toddler playgroup sniffles manageable with routine home self-care.
